name: Retrieve a specific sensitivity group template.
description: Retrieve a specific sensitivity group template. Gets an available sensitivity group template. GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/dlp/sensitivity_groups/templates/{template_id}

name: Retrieve all sensitivity group templates in an account
description: Retrieve all sensitivity group templates in an account Lists available sensitivity group templates. GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/dlp/sensitivity_groups/templates
context:
GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/dlp/sensitivity_groups/templates
Lists available sensitivity group templates.
Required: account_id (path)

name: Creates a new sensitivity group.
description: Creates a new sensitivity group. Creates a sensitivity group, optionally from a template. POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/dlp/sensitivity_groups
context:
POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/dlp/sensitivity_groups
Creates a sensitivity group, optionally from a template.
Required: account_id (path); body (body) — Attributes of the new sensitivity group.

name: Delete a single sensitivity group.
description: Delete a single sensitivity group. Deletes a sensitivity group and its levels. DELETE /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/dlp/sensitivity_groups/{sensitivity_group_id}

name: Retrieve the ordered list of level IDs for a sensitivity group.
description: Retrieve the ordered list of level IDs for a sensitivity group. Gets the current order of sensitivity levels in a group. GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/dlp/sensitivity_groups/{sensitivity_group_id}/level_order
context:
GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/dlp/sensitivity_groups/{sensitivity_group_id}/level_order
Gets the current order of sensitivity levels in a group.
Required: account_id (path); sensitivity_group_id (path)

name: Retrieve all sensitivity groups in an account
description: Retrieve all sensitivity groups in an account Lists sensitivity groups configured for the account. GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/dlp/sensitivity_groups
context:
GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/dlp/sensitivity_groups
Lists sensitivity groups configured for the account.
Required: account_id (path)

name: Set the ordering of levels within a sensitivity group.
description: Set the ordering of levels within a sensitivity group. Updates the order of sensitivity levels in a group. PUT /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/dlp/sensitivity_groups/{sensitivity_group_id}/level_order
context:
PUT /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/dlp/sensitivity_groups/{sensitivity_group_id}/level_order
Updates the order of sensitivity levels in a group.
Required: account_id (path); sensitivity_group_id (path); body (body) — Desired ordered list of level IDs.

name: Retrieve a specific sensitivity group.
description: Retrieve a specific sensitivity group. Gets a sensitivity group and its levels. GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/dlp/sensitivity_groups/{sensitivity_group_id}

name: Update the attributes of a single sensitivity group.
description: Update the attributes of a single sensitivity group. Updates a sensitivity group and its levels. PUT /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/dlp/sensitivity_groups/{sensitivity_group_id}

name: Creates a new sensitivity level.
description: Creates a new sensitivity level. Creates a sensitivity level in a group. POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/dlp/sensitivity_groups/{sensitivity_group_id}/levels
context:
POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/dlp/sensitivity_groups/{sensitivity_group_id}/levels
Creates a sensitivity level in a group.
Required: account_id (path); sensitivity_group_id (path); body (body) — Attributes of the new sensitivity level.

name: Delete a single sensitivity level.
description: Delete a single sensitivity level. Deletes a sensitivity level from a group. DELETE /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/dlp/sensitivity_groups/{sensitivity_group_id}/levels/{sensitivity_level_id}

name: Retrieve all sensitivity levels in a sensitivity group
description: Retrieve all sensitivity levels in a sensitivity group Lists sensitivity levels in a sensitivity group. GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/dlp/sensitivity_groups/{sensitivity_group_id}/levels
context:
GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/dlp/sensitivity_groups/{sensitivity_group_id}/levels
Lists sensitivity levels in a sensitivity group.
Required: account_id (path); sensitivity_group_id (path)

name: Retrieve a specific sensitivity level.
description: Retrieve a specific sensitivity level. Gets a sensitivity level from a group. GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/dlp/sensitivity_groups/{sensitivity_group_id}/levels/{sensitivity_level_id}

name: Update the attributes of a single sensitivity level.
description: Update the attributes of a single sensitivity level. Updates a sensitivity level in a group. PUT /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/dlp/sensitivity_groups/{sensitivity_group_id}/levels/{sensitivity_level_id}
